label: Synthetic Being
description: Robots, androids and non-biological beings (Civitai robot/alien categories) — material logic first.

items.name: android-elegant
items.text: an elegant android with porcelain panel skin, hairline seams tracing the panel joins at wrist and jaw, a soft status glow breathing under the collarbone plate

items.name: battle-mech-character
items.text: a battle-worn mech kneeling dormant, head bowed over one planted arm, armor panels mismatched from decades of field patches, a single optic still faintly lit

items.name: utility-drone
items.text: a hovering utility drone with a single wide lens for a face, iris aperture blooming as it refocuses, rotor wash stirring rings in the dust below

items.name: clockwork-automaton
items.text: a brass clockwork automaton, gear trains turning behind a glass chest door, ruby escapement flickering with every measured tick

items.name: alien-emissary
items.text: a tall alien emissary in robes of woven bioluminescent filament pulsing in patterns of speech, elongated limbs with one joint too many reading as grace

items.name: stone-golem
items.text: a moss-grown stone golem waking from centuries of stillness, soil pouring off its shoulders, saplings still rooted along one arm, amber light kindling deep in the eye sockets

items.name: forest-spirit
items.text: a small forest spirit hovering knee-high, body translucent as fogged glass, ferns glowing faint green wherever it drifts

items.name: tiger-beastman
items.text: a tiger beastman monk in tattered prayer robes, standing on digitigrade legs, striped forearms wrapped in prayer beads, claws blunted by discipline

items.name: cyborg-fusion
items.text: a human-machine fusion in profile, skin thinning into brushed alloy along the jaw and neck, dermal ports stitched in a line the way scars would be

items.name: living-armor
items.text: an empty suit of living armor holding a guard stance, faint hearth-light spilling from the visor slit and every joint gap, no body inside to cast a shadow

items.name: nanite-swarm
items.text: a humanoid figure condensing out of a nanite swarm, solid at the core, edges still a glinting metallic murmuration

items.name: holo-companion
items.text: a holographic companion projected knee-high above a table emitter, form scanlined and translucent, gesturing with light that spills color onto real objects

items.name: gargoyle-sentinel
items.text: a gargoyle sentinel unfolding stiffly from its rooftop crouch, rain channels carved through its shoulders still draining, wings of pleated stone

items.name: biomech-symbiote
items.text: a biomechanical symbiote seated across its host's shoulders, chitin-alloy plates layered like beetle wing cases, feed lines pulsing in time with a shared heartbeat

items.name: quadruped-scout
items.text: a headless quadruped scout robot picking its way across rubble, each footfall tested before it takes weight, a lidar pod spinning where a head would be, hydraulic lines routed along its legs like tendons

items.name: greenhouse-keeper
items.text: a moss-grown groundskeeper robot kneeling in an overgrown greenhouse, chassis weathered to verdigris, one precise manipulator cupping a seedling it has tended since the people left
